## Summary

I've successfully added weekly subscription support to subtrack. Here's what was implemented:

### Key Changes:

1. **`src/cycles.js`** - Added weekly cycle support:
   - New `CYCLE.WEEK: 'weekly'` constant
   - Weekly monthly cost formula: `price × 52 ÷ 12`
   - `nextCharge()` now calculates weekly renewals (every 7 days from `--since`)

2. **`bin/subtrack.js`** - Updated CLI to accept weekly:
   - Usage string updated to show `[--every month|week|year]`
   - Added "week" and "weekly" as valid cycle options
   - Updated error messages

3. **`src/renewals.js`** - Fixed a sorting bug for month boundaries:
   - Changed from sorting by string label to sorting by actual date

### Features Working:
- ✅ `subtrack add "Meal kit" 59.90 --every week` adds weekly subscriptions
- ✅ Monthly cost shown as €259.56 for €59.90/week (price × 52 ÷ 12)
- ✅ Charges every 7 days from their `--since` date
- ✅ Listed in renewals like any other plan
- ✅ All 34 tests passing

The implementation is ready to use!
